import json, subprocess
base = json.load(open('examples/input.json'))
def run_raw(data):
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','submission/main.py'], input=data, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout.decode()[:60], p.stderr.decode()[:60]
def run(doc):
    return run_raw(json.dumps(doc).encode())

raw["array root"] = b'[]'
raw["dup key nested"] = json.dumps(base).replace('"draw": 0','"draw": 0, "draw": 1',1).encode()

raw["float slot"] = json.dumps(base).replace('"slots": 2','"slots": 2.0').encode()
raw["exp notation"] = json.dumps(base).replace('"slots": 2','"slots": 2e0').encode()
